version.changelog: - Updated version number in SKILL.md metadata from 0.22.4 to 0.22.5.

llm.summary: This customer-support persona is a simple, disclosed Google Workspace workflow guide with no bundled code, hidden persistence, or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Access to support-labeled Gmail and workspace tools is proportionate for a customer-support persona, though users should connect only the accounts and spaces intended for support operations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file declaring required gws utilities and related skills; no executable installer, dependency download, or remote payload is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are brief and include real workspace side effects such as appending to Sheets, posting escalations to Chat, and inserting Calendar events, but they are disclosed and tied to support workflows rather than hidden or unrelated actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system persistence, background service, memory writing, tool wrapping, privilege escalation, or local credential handling is specified in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar capabilities match the stated customer-support purpose of triaging support mail, tracking tickets, escalating issues, and scheduling follow-ups.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for a Google Workspace account, support inbox label, tracking sheet, Chat space, and calendar where the agent is allowed to handle customer-support work. Confirm messages, escalations, and calendar inserts before letting the agent perform them automatically.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The scanner's activation-scope concern is partially valid as a usability caution: the description is broad, but the artifact's actual instructions focus on support-labeled email and expected support actions across declared workspace tools.
[SQP-1] expected: The workflow can create external side effects in Sheets, Chat, and Calendar, but these are disclosed and purpose-aligned; the absence of explicit confirmation language is best handled as user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
